description: Every podcast CanonCannon tracks, with its episode count — the roster that forms the denominator of the canon bar (an idea needs ceil(5%) of these shows to clear it). Requires a CanonCannon API key via _apiKey. Example: canon_podcast_list({ limit: 100 }).

_apiKey.description: CanonCannon API key (cc_live_...). Every /api/v1 endpoint refuses without it. Keys are issued by CanonCannon — https://canoncannon.com

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.
